shop.name: Fieldnote Active
shop.intro: Training layers worn and filmed by the people who sweat in them. Open a clip to see how each piece moves.

features.title: Arc-cut waistband
features.body: The rise curves higher at the back, so it stays put through deep squats and long hinges.

features.title: Brushed matte finish
features.body: A soft nylon blend with no gloss under gym lights.

features.title: Gusset that moves with you
features.body: A diamond gusset gives full range in lunges and lateral work.

reviews.quote: I did a full leg day in these and never once hiked the waistband up. It just stays where I put it.
reviews.author: Maya R.
reviews.highlight: never once hiked the waistband up

reviews.quote: Firm hold without feeling like I'm wearing a wetsuit. The clay colour is lovely in daylight.
reviews.author: Dana K.

reviews.quote: Squat-tested in front of a window. Nothing shows through.
reviews.author: Elise T.

features.title: Knitted in one piece
features.body: Circular knitting removes side seams, so nothing rubs on long flows.

features.title: Zoned rib texture
features.body: Tighter ribs at the core and looser knit at the knee.

features.title: Top and legging included
features.body: Sold as a matched set, priced below buying both pieces.

reviews.quote: No seams means no red lines after a ninety-minute class. That alone sold me.
reviews.author: Noor A.

reviews.quote: The fog colour looks expensive. I wear the top on its own on weekends.
reviews.author: Jess W.

reviews.quote: Size down if you are between sizes, it gives a little.
reviews.author: Priya S.

features.title: Five-inch inseam that stays down
features.body: A silicone hem grip keeps the leg from riding up on sprints.
features.highlight: keeps the leg from riding up

features.title: Two drop-in phone pockets
features.body: Deep enough for a large phone, flat against the thigh.

features.title: Quick-dry weave
features.body: Dries in about half the time of a cotton-blend short.

reviews.quote: Ran a hot 10k and the hem never moved. Pockets held my phone without bouncing.
reviews.author: Lena O.

reviews.quote: Mint is softer in person than on screen, in a good way.
reviews.author: Carmen V.

reviews.quote: Finally a short that doesn't need adjusting between sets.
reviews.author: Hana B.

features.title: Medium support, longline cut
features.body: A deeper band spreads the hold, so it sits flat under a crop.

features.title: Removable cups
features.body: Shaped cups that stay in place in the wash.

features.title: Crossback straps
features.body: Straps sit wide of the shoulder blades for overhead work.

reviews.quote: The band doesn't roll when I do ab work, which every other longline does.
reviews.author: Amara J.

reviews.quote: Plum is the colour I didn't know I needed.
reviews.author: Sasha L.

reviews.quote: Enough support for HIIT and soft enough to wear all day.
reviews.author: Rae M.

features.title: Ankle-skimming 7/8 length
features.body: Ends above the ankle bone, so it clears trainers and cleats.

features.title: Sweat-wicking knit
features.body: Pulls moisture to the outer face, where it dries fastest.

features.title: Hidden key pocket
features.body: A small zip pocket inside the back waistband.

reviews.quote: Perfect for suspension training. Nothing bunches at the ankle.
reviews.author: Ivy C.

reviews.quote: I'm 5'3 and the 7/8 is full length on me, which I love.
reviews.author: Mei H.

reviews.quote: The key pocket is small but it is exactly what I needed for runs.
reviews.author: Tara D.

features.title: Contrast side panel
features.body: A stripe down the outer leg that lengthens the line.

features.title: Band-friendly fabric
features.body: Grips resistance bands so they don't slide on the thigh.

features.title: High-rise, double layer
features.body: Two layers at the waist for a smooth front.

reviews.quote: My mini band stays exactly where I put it on these. Big deal for glute days.
reviews.author: Zoe P.
reviews.highlight: stays exactly where I put it

reviews.quote: Bold colour, but the stripe makes it easy to style.
reviews.author: Ada N.

reviews.quote: Runs slightly long. I'd love a petite length.
reviews.author: Kim R.

features.title: Wide rib that holds its shape
features.body: The rib recovers after a stretch instead of bagging out at the knee.

features.title: Sports bra with a high neck
features.body: Covers more for overhead presses and inversions.

features.title: Garment-dyed colour
features.body: Each piece is dyed after sewing for a soft, even tone.

reviews.quote: Lifted heavy all morning and the knees still looked new by lunch.
reviews.author: Bea K.

reviews.quote: Sage is calm and photographs beautifully.
reviews.author: Rosa F.

reviews.quote: The high neck is great for yoga, nothing slips.
reviews.author: Jo E.

features.title: Wrap front with thumbholes
features.body: Ties at the waist and keeps your hands warm between sets.

features.title: Lightweight brushed back
features.body: Warm on the walk in, light enough to keep on for mobility.

features.title: Drops into a tote
features.body: Packs flat into its own back pocket.

reviews.quote: This is the layer I grab on cold mornings. It packs into my gym bag without creasing.
reviews.author: Ola T.

reviews.quote: Thumbholes are perfectly placed for barre.
reviews.author: Lucia G.

reviews.quote: Looks sharp enough for coffee after class.
reviews.author: Wren A.
